summary: Festival-theme bug-fix verification (both bugs FIXED) plus festival regression. BUG 1 (friendly artwork error): POST /api/admin/festival-theme/artwork (deepavali/banner) as admin returns HTTP 424 with plain-language detail 'The AI artwork service needs balance: open Profile → Manage plan → Universal Key → Add balance (or enable auto top-up), then try again.' — contains 'Universal Key', and does NOT contain 'litellm', 'OpenAIException' or 'failed to generate multimodal' (verified both via curl on the public URL and via the admin UI notice box [data-testid=festival-notice]). Note: generation itself fails in this environment because the Universal Key really is inactive — only the message matters here, and it is correct. BUG 2 (banner layout): shopper home Deepavali banner is 132px tall, title 'Happy Deepavali' sits 31.5px from the banner TOP (no empty band), subtitle 'Festive picks, lit-up prices' directly under it at 56.5px, and the diya row is pinned at the bottom edge (verified visually in screenshot + computed bounding boxes; diyaRow is position:absolute bottom:6 in code). REGRESSION: apply christmas → deepavali → clear via API works end to end (primary #14532D → #4C1D95 → restored admin's own #143D2E); Deepavali re-applied afterwards to restore pre-test state. REGRESSION SUITE: tests/test_festival_themes.py now passes 18/18 — it initially failed 1 test (test_every_festival_has_an_artwork_prompt) with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'core'; this was a TEST-FILE bug (missing sys.path setup, pytest doesn't put the backend root on sys.path), fixed by adding sys.path.insert to the test file. Preview Theme toggle on the Deepavali card also verified working. Console warnings observed (not blocking): 'shadow* style props deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' (web), expo-notifications listener unsupported on web.

rca_of_issue: test_every_festival_has_an_artwork_prompt failure: pytest rootdir is /app/backend but pytest (rootdir-based sys.path handling with no ini) does not add /app/backend to sys.path, so 'from core.festival_themes import get_festival' inside the test raised ModuleNotFoundError. Direct python import from /app/backend worked. Mitigation: sys.path.insert(0, Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]) at the top of the test file.
